chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Abī Bashīr, from Ḥammād ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, who said: Zurārah ibn Aʿyan narrated to me, saying:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Two men pray at one and the same time, and one of them performs the ʿAṣr prayer early while the other delays the Ẓuhr prayer. He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.وَقْتٍ: time; the relevant prayer time period

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for one person to pray ʿAṣr early while another delays Ẓuhr at the same time?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling regarding the timing of Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr prayers. It indicates that if two people pray at the same time, with one advancing ʿAṣr and the other delaying Ẓuhr within the valid prayer period, there is no problem in that.
